message:
Running command: bash -lc 'python3 - <<"PY"
from pathlib import Path
for doc in [b"<a", b"<abc", b"<a><b", b"<a ", b"<a x", b"<a x=\"1\"", b"<"+b"a"*60000]:
 name="case"+str(abs(hash(doc)))
 Path(f"/tmp/{name}.xml").write_bytes(doc)
 Path(f"/tmp/{name}.fuzz").write_bytes(b"\0\0\0\0\0\0\0\0doc.xml\\\n"+doc+b"\\\n")
PY
for f in /tmp/case*.fuzz; do echo ===$(basename $f)===; ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=0:halt_on_error=0 /tmp/xml_fuzz_run $f >/tmp/out 2>&1; rc=$?; if [ $rc -ne 0 ] || grep -q "ERROR: AddressSanitizer" /tmp/out; then echo rc=$rc; head -80 /tmp/out; fi; done'
